name: Existing User Passkey Registration
summary: Adds a passkey to the current durable user without creating or switching identity.

preconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == challenge-issued and session-capability in [authenticated-limited,authenticated-normal,step-up]

setup: Issue a user-bound passkey registration challenge excluding existing credentials.

inputs.description: Valid WebAuthn attestation from the secure component.

postconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == passkey-proved and session identity is unchanged
